## About
Dee's Plumbing is employee owned and operated, with our office on Cash Road in Stafford. You're not just a number or a service call to us. We want to build a lasting relationship with every customer, and today we're servicing the great grandchildren of the folks who first called us.
Randy Krahn is our Texas Master Plumber, and you'll likely meet Eddie and Don too. Reviewers call the work clean and professional, and one mentioned Randy taking his time to share tips and advice.
Being close by matters. Traffic around here can slow down a plumber coming from across town, and knowing what each nearby city requires can save you time and money. Neighbors have given us a 4.8 from 24 Google reviews.

## Services
- Water Heaters: Repair and replacement. One reviewer's failing water heater was swapped for a new Rheem by Eddie and Don.
- Toilet Repairs & Replacement: From a noisy fill valve to a full replacement. One customer said Randy explained exactly what he fixed.
- Gas Lines & Leaks: Gas line work and leak repair, including a gas line for a generator for one reviewer.
- Install Gas Fireplace Logs: Gas fireplace log installation for your home.
- Kitchen Remodels: Plumbing for kitchen remodels, done clean and professional.
- Bathroom Remodels: Plumbing for bathroom remodels.
- Commercial Plumbing Repairs: Repairs for local businesses as well as homes.
- Sewer Cleaning: Sewer line cleaning for homes and businesses.

## FAQ
Q: What areas do you serve?
A: From our office in Stafford we serve Stafford, Sugar Land, Missouri City, Meadows Place, Richmond, and Southwest Houston.

Q: Who is your master plumber?
A: Randy Krahn is our Texas Master Plumber, license #11379.

Q: Do you test and install backflow devices?
A: Yes. We handle backflow device testing and installation, and one reviewer had us repair a backflow preventer.

Q: Do you work on businesses as well as homes?
A: Yes. We do commercial plumbing repairs, and our trained people service homes and businesses alike.
